options.label: Graphics backend
options.description: How the PS3 picture is drawn. Vulkan is faster and better supported.

options.label: Internal resolution
options.description: Draws games at a higher resolution for a sharper picture. Higher settings cost speed.

options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: The TV shape the PS3 tells the game it has; most games then draw in that shape. Stretch fills the whole screen.

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: Sharp keeps hard pixel edges; Smooth blurs them slightly when the picture is scaled to the screen.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Syncs frames to the screen to stop tearing. Can add a little input lag.

options.label: Show FPS
options.description: Shows the frame rate in a corner of the screen.

notes: RPCS3 reads ~/.config/rpcs3/config.yml at every boot (rpcs3/Emu/System.cpp:507, 606-622; Utilities/File.cpp get_config_dir: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME or ~/.config, + /rpcs3/, no config/ subdirectory off Windows). It writes it only when missing or empty (:525) or when the player saves in its settings dialog.

Then a per-game ~/.config/rpcs3/custom_configs/config_<TITLEID>.yml (or <eboot>.yml), when the player made one, is applied over it and wins for every key it holds (rpcs3/Emu/System.cpp:1802-1830; rpcs3/Emu/system_utils.cpp:573-581). Without one, RPCS3's game database config is applied over config.yml for the games that have one (rpcs3/Emu/System.cpp:1765-1775, 1839-1845).

Keys are the Video node's (rpcs3/Emu/system_config.h:116): Renderer :119, Aspect ratio :125, VSync Mode :131, Stretch To Display Area :143, Resolution Scale :168 (uint 25..800, percent), Output Scaling Mode :181, Performance Overlay/Enabled :203-205.

Enum spellings from fmt_class_string (rpcs3/Emu/system_config_types.cpp): Renderer OpenGL/Vulkan :28-29; Aspect ratio 4:3/16:9 :67-68; Output Scaling Mode Nearest/Bilinear :715-716 (FidelityFX Super Resolution left out: an upscaler, not a filter choice); VSync Mode Disabled/Adaptive/Full :779-781. Booleans true/false (Utilities/Config.h:207).

4:3 and 16:9 are written unquoted, as RPCS3 itself writes them: yaml-cpp's emitter only quotes a ':' followed by a blank or the end (3rdparty yaml-cpp 51a5d62, src/exp.h:165-168, src/emitterutils.cpp:156-198).

Both renderers are offered on Linux: OpenGL is supported everywhere but macOS (rpcs3/rpcs3qt/render_creator.cpp:85-90), Vulkan when an adapter is found (rpcs3/main_application.cpp:72-91); an unsupported choice falls back to the default renderer (rpcs3/Emu/System.cpp:316-322).

Aspect ratio is the TV shape reported to the game (rpcs3/Emu/Cell/Modules/cellVideoOut.cpp:151), not a display crop; Stretch To Display Area fills the window instead of letterboxing (rpcs3/Emu/RSX/VK/VKPresent.cpp:639, GL/GLPresent.cpp:265). Stretch therefore also writes Aspect ratio 16:9 (RPCS3's default, system_config.h:125).
Performance Overlay at its default Detail level (medium) shows the FPS (rpcs3/Emu/RSX/Overlays/overlay_perf_metrics.cpp:592-604).
